en.title: Add a Payer
en.summary: Register an employer or insurer that pays for some patients' care. It starts pending.

sections.heading: What to fill in
sections.body: Name as it should appear on bills, TIN, phone, email and address. Subcity comes from the list in the Admin Panel; if the one you need is missing, add it there first.

sections.heading: After saving
sections.body: The payer waits in Approvals → Payers until it is approved — normally by somebody other than the person who added it. Then it can be chosen on a patient's registration and under Bill to on a draft bill.

am.title: ከፋይ መጨመር
am.summary: ለአንዳንድ ታካሚዎች ሕክምና የሚከፍል አሠሪ ወይም መድን ሰጪ ይመዝግቡ። በመጠባበቅ ላይ ሆኖ ይጀምራል።

sections.heading: የሚሞላው
sections.body: በደረሰኞች ላይ መታየት ያለበት ስም፣ TIN፣ ስልክ፣ ኢሜይልና አድራሻ። ክፍለ ከተማ ከአስተዳደር ፓነል ዝርዝር ይመጣል፤ የሚፈልጉት ከሌለ መጀመሪያ እዚያ ይጨምሩት።

sections.heading: ካስቀመጡ በኋላ
sections.body: ከፋዩ በApprovals → Payers እስኪጸድቅ ድረስ ይጠብቃል — ብዙውን ጊዜ የሚያጸድቀው የጨመረው ሰው ሳይሆን ሌላ ሰው ነው። ከዚያ በታካሚ ምዝገባና በረቂቅ ደረሰኝ "Bill to" ላይ መመረጥ ይችላል።
